input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes a field-of-use / non-compete restriction on the Company (our party): during the term it may not participate in any similar Internet project with respect to Deerskin Products "or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products," expressly sweeping in third-party competitor lines (Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and "companies similar" to them). That is an open-ended limit on the products we may source, build or sell online, with no carve-out for internal development or acquired businesses. The reciprocal restriction on HDI in Section 6.3 is acceptable (it binds the vendor). Because HDI funds the Site and the Deerskin-brand exclusivity is the core bargain, we took the fallback rather than outright deletion: the restriction is limited to a self-contained "Deerskin" branded consumer web site, remains term-only (Section 4.1 term is one year with annual renewals terminable on 90 days' notice, so no post-term tail), and carve-outs for other channels, internal development and acquisitions are added.

proposal.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 exclusivity so it binds the Company only as to a Deerskin-branded Site, with carve-outs for other channels, internal development and acquisitions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept restrictions on the products we may source, build or sell, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to protect HDI's exclusivity for the Deerskin-branded Site only and added carve-outs for other channels, internal development and acquisitions. Our preferred position is deletion of any restriction on the Company; this narrowed form is offered as a compromise given HDI's investment in the Site.

ops.oldText: the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and
ops.newText: the Company shall not operate a self-contained web site offering Deerskin Products under the "Deerskin" brand directly to consumers on the Internet, and

ops.text: Nothing in this Section 6.1 shall restrict the Company or any of its affiliates from (i) developing, sourcing, marketing, distributing or selling any products (including products substantially similar to Deerskin Products) through any channel other than a self-contained "Deerskin" branded web site, (ii) any internal development activity, or (iii) continuing to operate any business acquired by, or merged with, the Company or any of its affiliates.
